## Description

Please include a summary of the change, related issues, and the motivation behind it.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Performance optimization or refactor
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (`ruff check` and `ruff format` pass)
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] All existing and new tests pass locally (`pytest`)
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly (if applicable)
- [ ] My changes maintain epistemic honesty and contain no artificial hardcoded hallucinations
